faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The most common questions from people buying, selling or renting with us.

items.question: How long does it take to sell or rent a property?
items.answer: It depends on the type of property, location and asking price. We track how your property performs in the market and adjust the strategy with you throughout the process, backed by 22 years of local experience in Odivelas.

items.question: Does the property valuation cost anything?
items.answer: No. The valuation is free and comes with no obligation, based on real comparable properties in the local market.

items.question: What documents do I need to sell my property?
items.answer: Usually the land registry certificate, property description certificate, occupancy permit (where applicable) and energy certificate. Your consultant helps you gather everything you need.

items.question: Does RE/MAX Radial only work in Odivelas?
items.answer: Our office is based in Odivelas, but we also handle properties in the surrounding area, with access to the RE/MAX network nationally and internationally.

items.question: How can I contact a consultant?
items.answer: Through the contact form, WhatsApp, phone, or by visiting our office at Av. 25 de Abril, Odivelas.
